 INVESCO QQQ Trust ( QQQ ) recorded net buying of $668.2 million on Friday, Oct. 23, with gross ETF activity matching that figure as the fund sold no stock. All 101 positions were increased and none were decreased. The fund's assets under management stand at $476.67 billion. 
 What did QQQ buy on Friday? 
 Is QQQ fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator. 
 Its largest buys by dollar value were NVDA ($54.2 million), AAPL ($54.1 million) and MSFT ($41.5 million).

 The largest buy was NVIDIA Corp ( NVDA ), where 256,823 shares were added for $54.2 million, giving it an 8.11% weight. Apple Inc ( AAPL ) followed with 155,534 shares bought for $54.1 million at an 8.09% weight, then Microsoft Corp ( MSFT ) with 79,135 shares for $41.5 million at 6.21%. Micron Technology Inc ( MU ) added 33,231 shares for $29.2 million at 4.36%, and Amazon.com Inc ( AMZN ) added 114,931 shares for $28.5 million at 4.27%. No new positions were opened and no holdings were fully exited. 
 How does QQQ invest? 
 INVESCO QQQ Trust ( QQQ ) is an equity fund holding 101 stocks, with 46.7% of assets in its 10 largest holdings. Technology accounts for 58.0% of the stocks that could be classified, Communication Services 11.8% and Consumer Cyclical 10.8%. All holdings are large-cap (100.0%), and the expense ratio is 0.18%. Its top holdings are NVIDIA Corp at 8.11%, Apple Inc at 8.09%, Microsoft Corp at 6.21%, Micron Technology Inc at 4.36% and Amazon.com Inc at 4.27%. The fund has a GF Score of 87, a P/E of 28.72, a P/B of 6.99, a dividend yield of 0.42% and a year-to-date return of 16.33%.
